# Steer Me Right

> Austin-based car buying and negotiation service supporting buyers nationwide. The Steer Me Right plan is $395 USD one time for one model; Steer Me Right Pro is $695 USD one time for up to three models. Pricing, availability, and outcomes vary by purchase.

Updated: 2026-11-10

Steer Me Right was called Drive Right Car Buying (driverightcarbuying.com) until October 30, 2026. Steer Me Right is a service-area business. It does not operate storefronts in each metro. Public contact: hello@steermeright.com.

## Primary pages

- [Home](https://www.steermeright.com/): Overview of the service, plans, nationwide support, and how Steer Me Right compares vehicles and deal terms.
- [Car buying service](https://www.steermeright.com/car-buying-service.html): Service scope, current fees, and buyer responsibilities.
- [How it works](https://www.steermeright.com/how-it-works.html): Process, listed fees, buyer responsibilities, and current disclosures.
- [Plans and pricing](https://www.steermeright.com/schedule.html): $395 Steer Me Right (one model) and $695 Steer Me Right Pro (up to three models), each a one-time service fee. Steer Me Right clients can upgrade to Pro for the $300 difference.
- [Machine-readable pricing](https://www.steermeright.com/pricing.md): Current fees, inclusions, and purchase-cost exclusions in Markdown.
- [About](https://www.steermeright.com/about.html): Founder Mason and the service approach.
- [Resource hubs](https://www.steermeright.com/blog.html): Index of decision guides. Several older articles remain unpublished to search pending source review.
- [Texas local markets](https://www.steermeright.com/texas-local-market-intelligence.html): Statewide service-area overview for nine Texas metros.
- [Policies](https://www.steermeright.com/policy.html): Privacy, terms, and refund policy.

## Practical resources
- [Compare car quotes](https://www.steermeright.com/compare-car-quotes.html): Free local worksheet for entered purchase costs, missing information and conditional incentives; no quote submission.
- [Compare complete new-car quotes](https://www.steermeright.com/blog-buy-new-car-below-msrp.html): Written offers, rebate eligibility and whole-quote comparison.
- [Dealership add-ons](https://www.steermeright.com/blog-dealership-addons-complete-guide.html): Questions about product cost, coverage and contract terms.
- [Used-car inspection checklist](https://www.steermeright.com/blog-used-car-inspection-checklist.html): Buyer observations, title/history/recall sources and questions for an independent mechanic.

## Comparisons
- [Car buying services compared](https://www.steermeright.com/compare-car-buying-services.html): Published fees, who negotiates, new or used coverage, refund terms and who pays each service for Steer Me Right, CarEdge, Delivrd, Car Pal, Automatch Consulting, Authority Auto, Costco Auto Program and Consumer Reports Build & Buy. Competitor facts checked 2026-10-18 on each company's own pages.
- [CarEdge alternatives](https://www.steermeright.com/caredge-alternatives.html): CarEdge's Concierge ($999 per car search) and AI Buying Agent compared with Steer Me Right and other services, including how CarEdge says it makes money.
- [Delivrd alternatives](https://www.steermeright.com/delivrd-alternatives.html): Delivrd's $1,000 Insta-Pay Deal Negotiation, its refund and change rules and its new-cars-only scope, compared with Steer Me Right and other services.
- [Used car buying service](https://www.steermeright.com/used-car-buying-service.html): Steer Me Right searches and negotiates used and CPO cars for $395 or $695; Delivrd negotiates new cars only (checked 2026-11-10).
- [Car negotiation service](https://www.steermeright.com/car-negotiation-service.html): What a car negotiation service (also searched as car buying agent or car buyer's advocate) does, how a Steer Me Right negotiation runs, and published fees for services where a person negotiates (checked 2026-11-10).
- [What a car buying service costs](https://www.steermeright.com/car-buying-service-cost.html): The four fee models (buyer-paid flat fee, share of savings, dealer-paid, software) and each published price, from $395 at Steer Me Right to $1,695 (checked 2026-11-10).
- [Is CarEdge Concierge worth it?](https://www.steermeright.com/is-caredge-concierge-worth-it.html): CarEdge Concierge's $999 per-car fee, scope, refund rule and dealer-side revenue, compared with Steer Me Right at $395 and $695 (checked 2026-11-10).
- [Delivrd review](https://www.steermeright.com/delivrd-review.html): Delivrd's $1,000 Insta-Pay fee, new-cars-only scope, refund and change rules, from its own pages (checked 2026-11-10).
